name.en: MC4-Evo 2 PV connector (plug and panel receptacle)
name.es: Conector fotovoltaico MC4-Evo 2 (clavija y receptaculo de panel)

description.en: Staubli MC4-Evo 2 inline plug and panel receptacle: 1500 V DC, IP65/IP68 mated, cable 2.5, 4 and 10 mm2 (IEC) and AWG equivalents, -40 to +85 C ambient, IEC 62852 and UL 6703 cited.
description.es: Conector de linea MC4-Evo 2 de Staubli (clavija y receptaculo de panel): 1500 V CC, IP65/IP68 acoplado, cable de 2,5, 4 y 10 mm2 (IEC) con equivalentes AWG, -40 a +85 C ambiente, IEC 62852 y UL 6703 citadas.

unverified_items: Full outline dimensions not extracted (the three printed drawing values are not assigned to an axis).
Cable OD to cross-section mapping now taken from the variant table (S25); the plug variant names are printed by the manufacturer.
Standards are cited by the manufacturer, not verified against IEC 62852 or UL 6703.
Panel receptacle does not print cable OD values.
12 AWG current at 4 mm2 differs between the two Staubli copies (39 A in S6, 35 A in S25); not resolved.
